subject: Reseller addendum: proposed tiered marketplace pass-through language
messages:
From: CloudNova Legal <legal@cloudnova.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <ops@marketplace.cloud>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — pass-through fee language

Diego,

Thanks for sharing the draft addendum. Our legal team reviewed the pass-through paragraph and asked for a couple of clarifications before we can sign:

1) Can you confirm whether the marketplace fees will be applied as a percentage of list price or net-of-discounts?
2) We see a tiered fee table referenced in Section 2.2 but the thresholds aren't consistent with CloudNova's billing model — can we align thresholds to monthly spend buckets instead of annual?
3) The draft includes a "no-backcharge" clause for marketplace remittances. Our finance team prefers language that allows adjustments only for manifest administrative errors up to 90 days.

I've attached our suggested redline (PDF) and a short note from finance. If it's helpful, we can schedule a short call with Marketplace Ops and your legal so we can get to agreeables faster.

Best,
Leah Morgan
Counsel, CloudNova
legal@cloudnova.com

Attachment: marketplace_terms_snapshot_20261110.pdf

From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: CloudNova Legal <legal@cloudnova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marketplace Ops <ops@marketplace.cloud>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — pass-through fee language

Leah — thanks for the quick review and the notes. Appreciate the clarity.

Quick answers:
- Redwood intends the marketplace fee to be applied on net-of-discounts (post-coupon) for customer-facing pricing. We can make that explicit.
- We can certainly switch the thresholds to monthly spend buckets — that actually maps better to how our billing signals run.
- On backcharges: we are open to the 90-day administrative-error window, but want to keep a narrow carve-out for fraud or proven double-billing beyond that window.

I've attached an internal redline (reseller_addendum_redline.docx) that:
- switches language to "net-of-discounts"
- replaces the annual thresholds with monthly buckets and an example table
- adds limited fraud carve-out language while adopting the 90-day correction period for administrative errors

Can Marissa and Karthik review the attached and confirm the revised wording is acceptable from Redwood's perspective? If possible, let's aim to close with a 30-minute sync tomorrow afternoon (11/13) to walk Marketplace Ops through the table and finalize.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com
Attachment: reseller_addendum_redline.docx

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, CloudNova Legal <legal@cloudnova.com>, Marketplace Ops <ops@marketplace.cloud>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — pass-through fee language

Diego / Leah — I reviewed the redline. High level: agree with net-of-discounts and monthly buckets. A few note-for-the-record items and one proposed tweak: 

- Section 2.2 (Fee Calculation): change "net-of-discounts" to "net of customer-specific discounts and credits" to avoid ambiguity around promotional credits Redwood issues directly to end customers.
- Section 2.3 (Adjustments): accept 90-day window for administrative errors. Add sentence: "Any adjustments sought after 90 days shall require mutual written consent and shall be limited to instances of demonstrable billing error or fraud."
- Section 4 (Order Forms): The redline currently references the Order Form as "Order Form (Marketplace)." Please update to cross-reference the Order Form ID field so we can programmatically match records for invoicing.
- Liability carve-out: the fraud carve-out Diego proposed is OK but we should narrow the definition of "fraud" to avoid open-ended exposure; I suggest: "fraud" means intentional misrepresentation of billing events as determined by mutually agreed forensic review.

I attached a short pricing spreadsheet (tiered_pricing_sheet.xlsx) showing the monthly buckets we propose: 0-$20k, $20-100k, $100k+. These are illustrative; ops can confirm.

If ops confirms the buckets, I think we're ready to have a short signatures-only addendum after clearing the fraud wording.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachment: tiered_pricing_sheet.xlsx

From: CloudNova Legal <legal@cloudnova.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops <ops@marketplace.cloud>
Date: 2026-11-13T10:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Reseller addendum — pass-through fee language

Marissa / Diego — thanks, that framing is helpful. Marketplace Ops reviewed the monthly buckets and confirmed the ranges are workable. A couple quick items from our end:

- CloudNova can accept "net of customer-specific discounts and credits" but we need the definition of "credits" to exclude refunds issued for service outages (those are reimbursements, not discounts). Can we add that exclusion?
- On the fraud definition: we can accept the proposed forensic-review path, provided the reviewers are independent and that each party bears its own costs unless fraud is substantiated, in which case the wrongdoer pays for the forensic costs.

We have a short redline attached (PDF) with these points. Assuming you accept, we can prepare DocuSign-ready signatures within 48 hours.

Regards,
Leah Morgan
Counsel, CloudNova
Attachment: cloudnova_redline_comments_20261113.pdf

From: diego_fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: CloudNova Legal <legal@cloudnova.com>, Marketplace Ops <ops@marketplace.cloud>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Reseller addendum — final steps and signature timeline

All — great progress, thanks. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Redwood accepts exclusion: refunds for outage reimbursements are excluded from "credits." We'll add a one-sentence carve-out.
- Forensic review language: agreed — independent reviewer; each party pays own costs unless fraud substantiated. We'll include tie-breaker arbitration clause for disputes over findings.
- Ops confirmed monthly buckets and pricing spreadsheet attached earlier is final.

Next steps: Marissa will prepare the clean addendum (final redline incorporated) and share a DocuSign envelope by EOD 11/16. CloudNova to review and sign within 48 hours to keep the launch timeline.

I'll open a short hubspot task and calendar block for post-signature kickoff. Thanks everyone for the rapid turnaround.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com
